QuestInfo.name: Progress on Fossil Research
QuestInfo.0: I hear Dr. #p308# has finished her fossil research. Maybe I should go and see the results.
QuestInfo.1: I visited Dr. #p308# again. She finally completed her research and asked if I could take the final report to Dr. #p512# in #m10004000#. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I were to take #b20 #t4000011#s#k, #b15 pieces of #t4000015##k, #b1 #t4031075##k, and #b1 pair of #t1032002##k, it'd make Dr. #p512# very happy.
QuestInfo.2: I delivered Dr. #p308#'s #t4031074# to Dr. #p512# in #m10004000#. Along with the report, I also gave him the #t4000011#, #t4000015#, #t4031075#, and #t1032002#. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the #t1032015#.

0.0: Been a while. Thanks to you, I have successfully completed my research.
0.1: The fossils you got for me were critical materials. Those fossils contain clues that may lead us to discover the secrets behind the special abilities of prehistoric life. If we can use them well, they will help us regular people out tremendously.
0.2: I need to send Dr. #p512# of #m10004000# the final report on the results of the studies. Can you help me out?

yes.0: I knew you'd help me out. Please get the final report to Dr. #p512#. Oh, before you go, gather #b20 #t4000011#s#k, #b15 pieces of #t4000015##k, #b1 #t4031075##k, and #b1 pair of #t1032002##k. I guarantee Dr. Winston will be very pleased... He may even reward you with something nice.
yes.1: Ahhh, you may have never heard of #b#t4031075##k. #b#t4031075##k is a rare crystal you can only get from the #r#o20##k.

no.0: You must be very busy. I'll have to ask someone else for this.

1.0: Welcome, welcome. You're the one that helped me get my fossils back the other day. I heard that you've also helped Dr. #p308# with her studies. She said she gave you the final report for me to look at. Did you bring it?
1.1: Please also give me the materials that you've gathered up. Those materials will be used to conduct studies regarding the final report. Dr. #p308# did tell you this in advance, right?

yes.0: Wow... A huge secret written in the fossils! The more I dig up fossils, the more they amaze me. They never cease to surprise me, on many levels.
yes.1: Do you like the earrings? They're the result of the studies we have conducted here. They are laden with the abilities of the #o6#, so use them wisely!

npc.0: Hand the report that I gave to you to Dr. #b#p512##k. Oh yeah! Before going, remember to take him #b20 #t4000011#s#k, #b15 pieces of #t4000015##k, #b1 #t4031075##k, and #b1 pair of #t1032002##k.

item.0: What's up? Aren't the fossil studies going well? I'm more than ready to take a look at the results...

lost.0: Did you lose the final report? My oh my, you better be really careful. Good thing I made a number of copies, in case something like this happened. Now, please get this to Dr. #p512# SAFELY.
